title: Careless typist fills every form badly
persona: A hurried person who types fast, makes typos, leaves fields blank and puts words or decimals where numbers go.
goal: Add two or three plants and edit one of the existing ones, filling the plant form carelessly each time: skip optional fields, type '2.5' or 'a few' as a quantity, leave the name empty once. See whether the app explains each problem.
success: at least one plant was saved and at least one validation message was seen
